text: hansgrohe is a brand of Hansgrohe SE. Masco Corporation (Livonia, Michigan; NYSE: MAS) owned 68 percent of Hansgrohe SE at 31 December 2025; the Klaus Grohe family of Schiltach holds 32 percent through its holding company Syngroh.
short: Hansgrohe SE is 68% owned by US-listed Masco Corporation; 32% is with the Klaus Grohe family.

source.name: Masco Corporation: Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
source.quote: We owned 68 percent of Hansgrohe SE at both December 31, 2025 and 2024.

additionalSources.name: Hansgrohe Group: Supervisory and Executive Board
additionalSources.quote: The Klaus Grohe family of Schiltach has 32 percent share of Hansgrohe SE with its administrative and holding GmbH, Syngroh.
additionalSources.note: The site blocks scripts; read in the Wayback Machine copy of 12 June 2026 (https://web.archive.org/web/20260612140206/https://www.hansgrohe-group.com/en/about-us/group/supervisory-and-executive-board), which also says: 'The majority shareholder is the Masco Corporation, headquartered in Livonia, Michigan. The corporation currently holds a 68 percent share of Hansgrohe SE.'

additionalSources.name: DutchNews.nl (Business Wire): Masco Corporation Enters Into an Agreement to Acquire Majority Stake in Easy Sanitary Solutions B.V.
additionalSources.quote: its majority-owned subsidiary Hansgrohe SE has entered into an agreement to purchase a majority stake in the Dutch company
